Q9029.reason: Hypotonic water absorbed across the bladder mucosa can cause fluid and electrolyte imbalance, so saline is the washout fluid.

Q9030.reason: The parties may modify a third-party beneficiary contract before the beneficiary assents, sues, or relies, and the son learned of it only after payment.

Q9031.reason: A general ban on assigning the contract leaves the right to payment assignable unless that right is specifically restricted.
